research.name: Great UI
research.note: Copy-paste React and Motion components with many page and theme transitions, pixel-dithered canvas wipes and a pixel-to-ASCII image.

effects: Pixel to ASCII image that pixelates and turns into ASCII art on hover
Pixel Swipe page transition and text animation with pixel-dithered noise edges drawn on canvas
Radial Gooey Menu using an SVG gooey filter with spring mouse tracking
Venetian blinds, sine wave, curtain and interlocking page transitions

unverified: The component source is in the public repository Saurabh-2607/GreatUI (277 stars, license reported by GitHub as NOASSERTION); this site research has not yet been redone as a repository research of Saurabh-2607/GreatUI.
Only the Pixel to ASCII preview was seen in a screenshot; the transitions and gooey menu are taken from changelog descriptions.
